chunk_alignment: identical bounds including the final partial block

ratio: raw signal bytes / all archive bytes including model, escapes, metadata and index; mtscomp .cbin + .ch
decoder: same ThreadPoolExecutor(8), same batches of at most 8 blocks; upstream mtscomp Reader.read_chunk bypasses LRU; no codec implementation edits

cache: before EACH decode run, sequentially pre-read the entire compressed archive and metadata; no decoded cache; OS caching not hard-guaranteed; available RAM checked; prewarm time reported separately
